title: Personal Guest Data Operation
description: A fixed, privileged Core operation uses this plan. Core reserves operationId durably and current authorization before provider dispatch. GET /api/personal-guest/v1/bindings/{id}/data-operations/{operationId} requires registered pinned mTLS and returns a plan only while the matching task and reservation are running. Owner, current access, frozen VM/disk identity, quota, actor permissions and resource scope are rechecked; a binding GET or heartbeat grants no data mutation. The Linux initializer accepts only a root-owned plan and formats only a positively blank independent disk once. No arbitrary command, path or provider credential is accepted. XFS project 49 covers the fixed workspace; the project hard limit must be enforced and read back before a success receipt. Completed receipts follow stable workspace identity across explicit certificate renewal. Lost format results retain the original dispatch marker and cannot cause another format.
